items.title: Critical bridges in Crimea and Kyiv damaged as Russia and Ukraine exchange large-scale attacks
items.brief: A section of the bridge connecting Russia and the occupied Crimean Peninsula has collapsed, images geolocated by CNN show, after Russia and Ukraine exchanged large-scale attacks for a second straight night.

items.title: Trump administration tightens restrictions on flow of AI chips ahead of China trip
items.brief: The Commerce Department on Monday tightened export restrictions designed to prevent China from accessing sensitive, AI-powering computer chips amid a dispute in the Trump administration over how to handle the issue.

items.title: Pizza Hut co-founder Dan Carney has died
items.brief: Dan Carney, who co-founded Pizza Hut with his brother nearly 70 years ago, has died, according to his alma mater Wichita State University and the Cerebral Palsy Research Foundation, which he chaired for 50 years.
